dialog.title: Ambar
dialog.subtitle: Virtual assistant for Roberto J. Vargas

dialog.disclaimer: I'm a virtual assistant and I can make mistakes. An external service processes your messages: don't share personal or confidential data. For pricing or timelines, talk to Roberto.
dialog.firstMessage: Hi, I'm Ambar. Tell me what you'd like to solve in your business and I'll tell you how Roberto can help.
